name: Daimoinon — 2 Intermediate — Essence of the Netherworld

system.description: Craft a mystic projectile in your hands: each turn expend one Blood Trait to add one level of aggravated damage (rate limited to one Trait per turn regardless of generation). Releasing the missile is a standard ranged attack that can be dodged. Armor and inanimate objects without mystical protection provide only half their usual protection. Distraction or wounds while building the missile force a Simple Test or it explodes in your hands, damaging you instead.
